question: How many paintings from the Rijksmuseum are in the collection?
reference: SELECT (COUNT(?w) AS ?n) WHERE { ?w a mc:Work ; mc:museum "rijksmuseum" }

question: How many paintings by Claude Monet are there?
reference: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?w) AS ?n) WHERE { ?w mc:artist ?p . ?p rdfs:label "Claude Monet" }

question: Which Vincent van Gogh paintings does the Met have?
reference: SELECT ?w WHERE { ?w mc:artist ?p ; mc:museum "met" . ?p rdfs:label "Vincent van Gogh" }

question: Which artists have paintings in all three museums?
reference: SELECT ?artist WHERE { ?w mc:artist ?p ; mc:museum ?m . ?p rdfs:label ?artist } GROUP BY ?artist HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) = 3)

question: How many artists have works in more than one museum?
reference: SELECT (COUNT(*) AS ?n) WHERE { { SELECT ?p WHERE { ?w mc:artist ?p ; mc:museum ?m } GROUP BY ?p HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?m) > 1) } }

question: Show me landscapes at the Rijksmuseum.
reference: SELECT DISTINCT ?w WHERE { ?w mc:museum "rijksmuseum" . { ?w mc:subject ?c } UNION { ?w mc:aiSubject ?c } ?c skos:prefLabel|skos:altLabel ?l . FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?l), "landscape")) }

question: Which Impressionist paintings show snow?
reference: SELECT DISTINCT ?w WHERE { { ?w mc:style ?s } UNION { ?w mc:inferredStyle ?s } ?s skos:prefLabel "Impressionism"@en . { ?w mc:subject ?c } UNION { ?w mc:aiSubject ?c } ?c skos:prefLabel|skos:altLabel ?l . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?l)) = "snow") }

question: How many paintings have subjects that were suggested by AI rather than recorded by the museum?
reference: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?w) AS ?n) WHERE { ?w mc:aiSubject ?c . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?w mc:subject ?c } }

question: Which paintings did the AI tag with night that the museum didn't?
reference: SELECT DISTINCT ?w WHERE { ?w mc:aiSubject ?c . ?c skos:prefLabel|skos:altLabel ?l . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?l)) = "night") FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?w mc:subject ?m . ?m skos:prefLabel|skos:altLabel ?ml . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?ml)) = "night") } }

question: When was Berthe Morisot born and when did she die?
reference: SELECT ?born ?died WHERE { ?p rdfs:label "Berthe Morisot" ; mc:birthYear ?born ; mc:deathYear ?died }

question: Which artists in the collection belong to the Hague School?
reference: SELECT DISTINCT ?artist WHERE { ?p mc:movement ?m ; rdfs:label ?artist . ?m skos:prefLabel "Hague School"@en }

question: How many paintings were begun in the 1880s?
reference: SELECT (COUNT(?w) AS ?n) WHERE { ?w a mc:Work ; mc:beginYear ?y . FILTER(?y >= 1880 && ?y <= 1889) }

question: How many paintings does each museum have?
reference: SELECT ?museum (COUNT(?w) AS ?n) WHERE { ?w a mc:Work ; mc:museum ?museum } GROUP BY ?museum

question: Which five artists have the most paintings?
reference: SELECT ?artist (COUNT(?w) AS ?n) WHERE { ?w mc:artist ?p . ?p rdfs:label ?artist } GROUP BY ?artist ORDER BY DESC(?n) ?artist LIMIT 5

question: Find paintings of boats from before 1870.
reference: SELECT DISTINCT ?w WHERE { ?w mc:beginYear ?y . FILTER(?y < 1870) { ?w mc:subject ?c } UNION { ?w mc:aiSubject ?c } ?c skos:prefLabel|skos:altLabel ?l . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?l)) IN ("boat", "boats", "ship", "ships", "sailing ship")) }

question: How many artist records were matched by a person approving an AI suggestion?
reference: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?a) AS ?n) WHERE { ?a mc:matchMethod "human-approved" }

question: How many paintings are not open access?
reference: SELECT (COUNT(?w) AS ?n) WHERE { ?w a mc:Work . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?w dcterms:license ?l } }

question: Which paintings are only attributed to, after, or imitating Vincent van Gogh?
reference: SELECT ?w WHERE { ?w mc:qualifiedArtist ?p . ?p rdfs:label ?l . FILTER(CONTAINS(?l, "Gogh")) }

question: Portraits of women at the Met
reference: SELECT DISTINCT ?w WHERE { ?w mc:museum "met" . { ?w mc:subject ?c1 } UNION { ?w mc:aiSubject ?c1 } ?c1 skos:prefLabel|skos:altLabel ?l1 . FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?l1), "portrait")) { ?w mc:subject ?c2 } UNION { ?w mc:aiSubject ?c2 } ?c2 skos:prefLabel|skos:altLabel ?l2 . FILTER(LCASE(STR(?l2)) IN ("woman", "women", "young adult woman")) }

question: Which Impressionist painters have works in more than one museum?
reference: SELECT ?artist WHERE { ?p mc:movement ?m ; rdfs:label ?artist . ?m skos:prefLabel "Impressionism"@en . ?w mc:artist ?p ; mc:museum ?mu } GROUP BY ?artist HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?mu) > 1)
